name: codex
title: Codex launcher
author: Bennett Garcia
summary: Launch Codex app-server agents through the Rust A2 bridge.
description: Adds New Codex agent and literal runtime/profile settings. Each launch gets a fresh principal, caller-driven request routing (human for human starts, coordinator preference for coordinator starts) and a new agent tab. Execution stays in the backend-owned Rust bridge. No automatic prompt, credential lookup/copy or native profile write by vqro; Codex owns authentication. Disabling this extension leaves existing processes intact.

needs.why: Codex runs in a backend-owned terminal through vqro-bridge-codex

works_with.without: The created agent remains available through human Control; request route configuration is reported unconfirmed, never replayed
Request route initialization is unconfirmed; native spawn is never retried
A created agent opens as its bridge terminal
The observed host remains reachable through the resource picker
